    Plot gallery¶

    Choose a figure to see how to make it with your own data in the app. The CLI and Python recipes reproduce each pictured example from the bundled demo or from downloadable data.

    ScanpathFixations and saccades over the text.
    Gaze heatmapWhere fixation time concentrates.
    Word-box heatmapFixation time within each word box.
    Fixations by lineFixations colored by their nearest text line.
    Saccade typesForward movements, skips, refixations, return sweeps and regressions.
    Two participantsTwo complete readings of a shorter text, labeled Participant A and Participant B.
    Raw gazeEyeLink gaze samples recorded at 1,000 Hz under translucent fixation markers.
    ReplayThe first forty fixations, played in reading order.
    Highlighted textMark a selected text span alongside its fixations.
    Redacted textA block over each word’s letters keeps the layout and hides the words.
    Title, caption & legendA titled, captioned figure with its legends placed around the plot.
    Across the experimentMean reading time per word across one participant’s recorded trials.
    Reading schematicA hand-drawn, two-line reading with snapped fixations and arced saccades.
    Fully customizableHeart-shaped fixations and curved arrows, in a design of your own.
